ops.title: capt-hook 9.16.0 (2026-07-15) — create PRs repo-local only, target-keyed PR cap + review slots, auto-enroll, unwatched canary; plugin.json version gates consumer cache
ops.body:
capt-hook 9.16.0 shipped 2026-07-15 answering "why do review PRs only target captain-hook": mostly the deliberate generic-create→general-pack route in the scanning-sessions skill (user killed it — create candidates now ALWAYS repo-local; only fixes to existing pack hooks cross repos via routing.py), plus a real cap bug (open PRs counted by origin repo_key, not PR target) and 12 never-enabled repos. Shipped: `open_pr_targets` (pr_url-parsed, distinct-URL, sole counting codepath), `review slots` pre-PR gate, `review update` pr_url validation, `--repo` lowercasing, `ReviewStore.enroll` auto-enrollment in `review run` (explicit disable sticks), status canary for unwatched sessions. Full diagnosis + accepted residuals in cc-notes note 487560ca; contract docs (SKILL.md/pr-workflow.md/review-cli.md) rewritten fix-only.

**Why:** the fleet's PR skew was ~80% policy, not bug — check the skill prompt before the code when brain behavior looks wrong.

**How to apply:** captain-hook GitHub PR count can legitimately exceed the dashboard cap until the 4 legacy PRs (#9-#12) close; builtin-pack fix candidates stay ineligible meanwhile. Consumer plugin caches resolve from `captain_hook/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` `version` — bump it every release (sat at 9.10.0 for six releases, freezing consumers; backlog task 08c38a81 automates it). Opus API stalls (network outage 2026-07-14/15) killed a 6-attempt workflow; codex/sol executed the same bounded brief cleanly — reroute lane on repeated infra stalls. Related: [[review-overhaul-wave-shipped]], [[capt-hook-release-rollout-gotchas]].
